blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Foundation models can reason about complex physical tasks, yet translating this intelligence into reliable robot execution remains challenging. We argue that a critical, often overlooked factor is the robot-use interface (RUI), which determines how agents express and execute physical actions. To systematically study its impact, we introduce RUIBench, comprising 30 manipulation tasks across five suites spanning world knowledge, in-context learning, discovery, dynamic interaction, and contact-rich manipulation. We further develop RUIKit, a unified framework that crosses six action abstractions with two interaction forms, yielding 13 interfaces under shared perception and control. In simulation, changing only the RUI shifts a frontier agent's success rate from 45% to 81%, and that of a fine-tuned 4B model from 13% to 47%. Our analysis reveals that effective interfaces reduce unnecessary decisions while preserving essential feedback, with their benefits shaped by agent behavior and physical uncertainty. We further uncover a verification gap, where agents frequently declare success despite observable failures, revealing the need for task-level verification beyond individual actions. Together, these findings establish RUI design as a critical factor in embodied agent reliability.
blocks.zh: 基础模型可以解释复杂的物理任务,然而将这种智能转化为可靠的机器人执行仍然具有挑战性. 我们争辩说,机器人-使用界面(RUI)是一个关键且经常被忽视的因素,它决定了特工如何表达和执行物理动作. 为了系统地研究其影响,我们引入了RUIBENCH, 包括跨越世界知识、内文学习、发现、动态互动和丰富的接触操纵的五个套件的30个操纵任务。 我们进一步发展了RUIKit,这个统一框架跨越了6个动作抽象和两种互动形式,在共同感知和控制下产生13个界面. 在模拟中,只改变RUI将前沿代理的成功率从45%转移到81%,而微调后的4B模型的成功率从13%调到47%. 我们的分析表明,有效的接口减少了不必要的决定,同时保留了基本的反馈,其好处是由代理人行为和身体不确定性决定的。 我们进一步发现一个核查差距,即尽管存在明显的失败,但代理人经常宣布成功,这表明除了个别行动之外,还需要进行任务一级的核查。 这些结论共同确定RUI的设计是体现的物剂可靠性的一个关键因素。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Foundation models are moving from understanding the physical world to acting in it [ 74 , 2 , 39 ] .
While vision-language-action models learn to predict robot actions [ 7 , 43 , 6 ] , recent agentic systems enable general-purpose models to control robots through tool calls and executable programs [ 52 , 76 , 15 , 27 , 45 , 16 ] .
This introduces a critical design choice beyond the model itself: how should an agent interact with a robot?
We define the robot-use interface (RUI) as the actions an agent can command and how they are organized for execution.
From low-level motion commands [ 3 , 4 ] and image-grounded points [ 25 , 57 ] to semantic skills [ 1 , 37 ] and executable programs [ 52 , 71 ] , the RUI determines what the agent must decide, what can be delegated to execution, and when control returns to the agent.
blocks.zh:
基金会模式正在从了解物理世界转向采取行动[74、2、39]。
虽然视觉语言-动作模型学习预测机器人动作[7,43,6],但最近的代理系统使得通用模型能够通过工具调用和可执行的程序控制机器人[52,76,15,27,45,16].
这引入了一个超越模型本身的关键设计选择:一个特工应该如何与机器人互动?
我们把机器人-使用界面(RUI)定义为一个特工可以指挥的行动,以及它们如何组织执行.
从低级运动指令[3,4]和图像基点[25,57]到语义技能[1,37]和可执行程序[52,71],RUI决定代理人必须决定什么,可以授权执行什么,当控制返回代理人时.

blocks.en:
This distinction becomes critical in complex physical tasks.
These tasks require agents to gather missing information, react to dynamic events, and correct errors through physical feedback.
An interface that demands a new model decision for every small movement can make execution costly and error-prone, while one that provides insufficient feedback may fail when the world deviates from the plan.
Thus, reliable execution depends not only on what an agent knows, but also on how decisions and feedback are distributed between the agent and the robot.
blocks.zh:
这种区分在复杂的物理任务中变得至关重要。
这些任务要求代理人收集缺失的信息,对动态事件作出反应,并通过物理反馈纠正错误.
每一个小运动都需要新的模型决定的接口,会使执行代价高昂,容易出错,而当世界偏离计划时,反馈不足的接口可能会失败.
因此,可靠的执行不仅取决于代理人知道什么,而且取决于代理人和机器人之间如何分配决定和反馈.

blocks.en:
However, existing embodied benchmarks compare models under fixed interfaces [ 47 , 82 , 18 , 84 , 23 ] , while interface studies typically examine selected design choices [ 27 , 64 , 68 ] .
Consequently, the impact of interface design remains poorly understood.
In our experiments, changing only the RUI shifts Claude Code’s success rate from 45% to 81%, far exceeding the average performance gap between two frontier agents ( Fig. 1 a).
This raises our central question: What makes a good robot-use interface?
blocks.zh:
然而,现有包含的基准在固定接口下比较模型[47,82,18,84,23],而接口研究通常审查选定的设计选择[27,64,68].
因此,对接口设计的影响仍然认识不足。
在我们的实验中,只改变RUI将克劳德代码的成功率从45%转移到81%,远远超过了两个边境代理人之间的平均性能差距(图1a)。
这引起了我们的中心问题: 是什么使得一个好的机器人-使用界面?

blocks.en:
To answer this question, we introduce RUIBench, a benchmark combining 30 agentic manipulation tasks with a controlled evaluation protocol.
These tasks go beyond simple pick-and-place, requiring agents to reason, acquire information through interaction, and adapt to changing physical conditions.
They span five suites: world knowledge, in-context learning, discovery, dynamic interaction, and contact-rich manipulation.
The protocol limits agents to RGB-D observations and robot states, keeps the environment evolving during model reasoning, and evaluates task success independently of the agents’ claims.
We further develop RUIKit, a unified framework that disentangles two design choices: action abstraction , which determines what an agent can command, and interaction form , which determines how actions are organized and executed.
RUIKit crosses six action abstractions with two interaction forms to instantiate 12 interfaces, plus a free-choice interface, all within a shared harness where only the RUI varies ( Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
为了回答这个问题,我们引入了RUIBENCH,这是将30项代理操纵任务与受控评价协议相结合的基准.
这些任务超越了简单的选址,要求代理商理性,通过互动获取信息,并适应不断变化的物理条件.
它们跨越五个套间:世界知识,内文学习,发现,动态互动,以及丰富的接触操纵.
协议将代理限制在RGB-D观测和机器人状态,使环境在模型推理过程中不断演变,并且独立于代理的主张来评价任务成功.
我们进一步发展了RUIKit,一个将两个设计选择分解的统一框架:动作抽象(Action craision),它决定着一个代理能够指挥什么,交互形式(Interactive form),它决定着如何组织和执行行动.
RUIKit通过两个交互形式交叉六个动作抽象,以即时化12个接口,加上一个自由选择接口,全部在只有RUI不同(图1)的共享带内.

blocks.en:
Across frontier and small models in simulation and 650 real-robot episodes with frontier agents, we find that effective RUIs reduce unnecessary decisions while preserving essential feedback ( Fig. 1 b), which also makes them easier for small models to learn ( Fig. 1 d).
Fine-grained interaction can fragment a clear plan into excessive model decisions, a failure we call execution fragmentation .
Composing actions into programs reduces this burden when agents effectively exploit multi-step execution and intermediate feedback.
However, real-world execution changes which interfaces are effective, as physical uncertainty demands more opportunities for local correction ( Fig. 1 c).
We further uncover a verification gap : agents frequently declare success despite observable failures, while checking individual actions does not guarantee task completion.
Together, these findings highlight the importance of allocating decisions, feedback, and verification at appropriate levels.
blocks.zh:
我们发现,有效的RUI在保存基本反馈的同时减少不必要的决定(图1b),这也使小型模型更容易学习(图1d)。
精细的交互可以把明确的计划 分解成过多的模型决定,
当代理人有效地利用多步骤的执行和中间反馈时,将行动纳入方案会减轻这种负担。
然而,由于物理不确定性要求有更多的地方更正机会(图1 c),因此界面有效的现实世界执行变化。
我们进一步发现核查差距:尽管存在明显的失败,但代理人经常宣布成功,而检查个别行动并不能保证任务的完成。
这些结论共同突出了在适当级别分配决定、反馈和核查的重要性。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • Agentic benchmark. We introduce RUIBench with 30 manipulation tasks across five suites and a controlled evaluation protocol for systematically studying RUIs. • Unified framework. We develop RUIKit, spanning 13 interfaces across six action abstractions and two interaction forms under shared perception and control. • Empirical insights. We reveal how decision burden, physical feedback, and task-level verification shape embodied performance across agents and environments.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们引入了RUIBench,在5个套房中执行30项操纵任务,并制定了系统研究RUI的受控评价协议. • 统一框架。 我们开发了RUIKit,跨越了13个界面,跨越了6个动作抽象和在共同感知和控制下的两个交互形式. • 经验见解。 我们揭示了决策负担、实际反馈和任务一级的核查如何体现不同行为者和环境的业绩。

Foundation models control robots through learned action policies [ 7 , 43 , 6 ] or interfaces that connect general-purpose models to physical actions.
Existing systems employ semantic skills and learned-policy tools [ 1 , 37 , 63 , 85 , 48 , 51 , 67 , 83 , 89 , 13 , 61 , 28 ] , executable programs [ 52 , 71 , 76 , 35 , 17 , 40 , 79 ] , spatial constraints and value maps [ 36 , 38 , 60 ] , image-grounded points and paths [ 25 , 57 , 86 , 74 , 50 , 45 , 33 , 88 ] , end-effector poses [ 44 ] , and discrete motion commands [ 3 , 15 , 31 ] .
However, these interfaces are typically developed within individual systems, making their independent effects difficult to isolate.
Recent studies compare selected action abstractions [ 27 ] , programmatic versus per-action execution [ 64 , 68 , 19 ] , interface families [ 53 , 65 , 4 , 91 ] , harness components [ 80 , 12 , 24 , 73 ] , and planner-policy interfaces [ 34 ] .
Yet how these design choices jointly shape agent behavior remains poorly understood.
RUIKit addresses this gap by disentangling action abstraction and interaction form , enabling controlled comparisons of their individual and combined effects on agent behavior.
blocks.zh:
基础模型通过学习到的行动政策[7,43,6]或连接通用模型与物理动作的接口来控制机器人.
现有系统使用语义技能和学习政策工具[1,37,63,85,48,51,67,83,89,13,61,28],可执行程序[52,71,76,35,17,40,79],空间约束和值图[36,38,60],图像定位点和路径[25,57,86,74,50,45,33,88],终端效应器构成[44],离散运动指令[3,15,31].
然而,这些接口通常是在单个系统内部开发的,使其独立效应难以分离.
最近的研究比较了选定的行动抽象[27]、方案与每项行动的执行[64、68、19]、接口家族[53、65、4、91]、利用组件[80、12、24、73]和规划政策接口[34]。
然而,这些设计选择如何共同塑造代理行为仍然不甚了解。
RUIKit通过解析动作抽象和交互形式来解决这一空白,从而能够对其个体和对代理行为的综合影响进行有控制的比较。

blocks.en:
Existing embodied benchmarks evaluate robot manipulation, generalization, and embodied reasoning [ 47 , 82 , 18 , 49 ] .
Recent efforts extend toward foundation-model agents, introducing tasks that demand multi-step reasoning, planning, and physical interaction [ 23 , 84 , 66 , 29 , 46 , 78 , 30 , 14 ] .
Evaluation protocols have also become more realistic, incorporating non-privileged observations, continuous physical time, and independent outcome scoring [ 84 , 23 , 65 ] , alongside time and cost considerations [ 26 , 87 , 81 , 41 , 42 ] .
However, these benchmarks rarely vary the interface in a controlled way, limiting our understanding of how interface design affects agents facing different interaction demands.
Moreover, physical task success does not necessarily imply that an agent correctly recognizes completion.
Prior studies investigate visual success detection and failure reasoning [ 21 , 54 , 22 , 90 ] , yet agents can still declare success despite incomplete tasks [ 58 , 84 , 23 ] .
RUIBench complements these efforts with 30 agentic tasks spanning five interaction demands and a protocol that separates physical outcomes from agents’ completion claims.
Together, RUIBench and RUIKit measure how interface design shapes both execution and completion judgment ( Tab. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
现有包含的基准评价机器人操纵、概括和包含的推理[47、82、18、49]。
最近的努力扩展到了基础模型代理人,提出了需要多步骤推理、规划和物理互动的任务[23、84、66、29、46、78、30、14]。
评价协议也变得更加现实,包括非特权观察、连续物理时间和独立结果评分[84、23、65],以及时间和费用考虑[26、87、81、41、42]。
然而,这些基准很少以控制的方式改变界面,限制了我们对界面设计如何影响面临不同交互需求的代理的理解.
此外,实体任务的成功并不一定意味着代理人正确承认完成。
先前的研究调查视觉成功检测和失败推理[21,54,22,90],然而尽管任务不完整,特工仍然可以宣布成功[58,84,23].
RUIBENCH为这些努力提供了补充,它承担了30项代理任务,涉及五个互动要求和一个协议,将实体结果与代理商的完成索赔分开。
RUIBench和RUIKit一起测量接口设计如何既执行又完成判断(Tab. 1).

For a given agent and task, it fixes the robot, perception, timing, and scoring, and varies the RUI through RUIKit ( Sec. 4 ).

对于给定的代理和任务,它会修正机器人,感知,时间,和评分,并通过RUIKit(sec.4 )来改变RUI.

blocks.en:
A clear task goal does not imply a fully specified path to achieving it.
Successful manipulation often requires agents to reason beyond the initial instruction, acquire information through interaction, and adapt to physical feedback.
RUIBench captures these demands through 30 tasks in five complementary suites ( Fig. 2 ). World knowledge requires reasoning from prior knowledge, as in the Tower of Hanoi. In-context learning requires using previously shown visual examples, as in building a house from a picture. Discovery requires physical exploration, as in finding a fake coin with a balance. Dynamic interaction requires responding to time-sensitive events, as in Simon Says. Contact-rich manipulation requires precise adjustments during contact, as in inserting a graphics card.
Negative controls confirm that tasks depend on their intended capabilities ( App. A ).
A scripted reference that solves all 70 control missions succeeds on only 6 of them when it ignores demonstrations, observations after the first frame, or mid-episode changes.
Of the 30 tasks, 11 adapt paradigms from developmental and comparative psychology, and 19 come from everyday games, puzzles, school experiments, and chores ( Tabs. 2 and 7 ).
These familiar settings make goals intuitive and outcomes interpretable while preserving the challenges of agentic decision-making.
blocks.zh:
明确的任务目标并不意味着实现这一目标的完全具体的途径。
成功的操纵往往需要代理商在初始指令之外进行推理,通过互动获取信息,并适应物理反馈.
RUIBENCH通过5个互补套房的30项任务(图2)来捕捉这些需求. 世界知识需要先天知识的推理,如河内塔. 内文学习需要使用先前显示的视觉实例,比如从图片中建房. 发现需要物理探索,如寻找有平衡的假币. 动态互动需要应对时间敏感事件,如西蒙·塞斯(英语:Simon Says). 接触力丰富的操纵需要在接触过程中进行精确的调整,如插入图形卡.
负控证实任务取决于预期能力(App.A.).
一个可以解决所有70个控制任务的脚本引用,当它忽略了演示,第一帧后的观察,或者中集变化时,只在其中6个上成功.
在这30项任务中,有11项从发展心理学和比较心理学中调整范式,19项来自日常游戏、谜题、学校实验和家务(Tabs.2和7 )。
这些熟悉的环境使目标直观和结果可以解释,同时保留代理决策的挑战。

blocks.en:
Each suite contains six tasks, with each task drawing on at least three of six underlying abilities: long-horizon planning, reasoning, memory, fine-grained control, speed, and bimanual coordination.
The suites emphasize different combinations of these abilities ( Tab. 2 ).
Each task includes three or four milestones to measure partial progress.
Twenty-five tasks use a Franka Research 3 arm with fixed and wrist cameras, while five use two ARX X5 arms with head and wrist cameras.
All tasks are implemented in Isaac Sim with Isaac Lab [ 56 ] .
Each task provides 15 development and 20 test missions from fixed seeds.
We retain only layouts that pass reachability, visibility, and graspability checks and can be solved by a scripted reference policy with privileged state, ensuring feasibility in simulation.
Prompts, task parameters, and scorers are configured on development missions, while all agents and RUIs are evaluated on the same held-out test missions.
blocks.zh:
每个套件包含6项任务,每个任务至少借鉴了6项基本能力中的3项:长视规划,推理,内存,精细的控制,速度,以及双人协调.
套房强调这些能力的不同组合(Tab. 2 ).
每项任务包括三个或四个里程碑,以衡量部分进展。
25项任务使用一个有固定和腕相机的Franka Research 3臂,而5项任务使用两个有头和腕相机的ARX X5臂.
所有任务在艾萨克西姆与艾萨克实验室执行[56].
每项任务提供15个开发任务和20个使用固定种子的测试任务.
我们只保留通过可达性、能见度和可捉性检查的布局,并且可以通过有特权状态的脚本参考政策来解决,确保模拟的可行性。
在发展任务中配置了提示器、任务参数和计分器,而所有代理人和RUI则在同一暂停测试任务中进行评价。

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价议定书

blocks.en: To isolate interface effects while preserving the demands of physical interaction, RUIBench enforces non-privileged observations, continuous physical time, and independent outcome evaluation.
blocks.zh: 为了在保持物理互动需求的同时隔离界面效应,RUIBench执行非特权观测,连续物理时间,独立结果评价.

blocks.en:
Agents receive task instructions, hints available to human operators, and, for in-context learning tasks, a previously shown video or image.
All other information comes from RGB-D cameras and robot-state readings through shared tools.
SAM 3 [ 10 ] detects and segments objects, while 3D positions are recovered from noisy sensor depth rather than privileged simulator states.
On 100 annotated frames, this pipeline detects 93% of objects with localization errors of 0.5 to 0.7 cm.
blocks.zh:
代理接收任务指令,给人类操作者提供提示,对于内文学习任务,则接收之前显示的视频或图像.
所有其他信息都来自RGB-D相机和通过共享工具的机器人状态读取.
SAM 3[10]探测器和片段物体,而3D位置则从吵闹的传感器深度中恢复,而不是特权模拟状态.
在100个注释框上,这个管道探测到93%的物体,其本地化误差为0.5至0.7厘米.

blocks.en:
The environment continues evolving while the agent reasons.
In simulation, each model response incurs a fixed 8 s delay, during which the robot holds its pose while other objects continue moving.
This approximates the 75th percentile of 4,067 responses measured from three frontier models, preventing differences in serving latency from confounding interface comparisons.
blocks.zh:
环境在继续演变,而产生作用的原因是什么。
在模拟中,每个模型响应都会发生固定的8s延迟,在此期间,机器人在其它物体继续移动时保持其姿势.
这大约是从三个前沿模型中测得的4,067个答复的第75百分位数,防止了在服务延迟方面的差异混淆接口比较。

blocks.en:
Each episode starts from a fresh simulator instance and ends when the agent declares completion, gives up, or reaches its turn budget or 30 min time limit.
For reference, scripted policies complete tasks in 38 s on average ( Tab. 2 ), while some dynamic events last only 16 to 20 s.
Reaching the goal does not end an episode.
Instead, success is determined independently from the physical trajectory, verified offline from execution logs, and withheld from the agent.
The agent must therefore decide when the task is complete, allowing its completion claims to be compared against actual physical outcomes.
blocks.zh:
每集从一个新的模拟实例开始,当代理宣布完成,放弃,或达到回合预算或30分钟时限时结束.
为参考,脚本政策平均完成38s的任务(Tab. 2),而一些动态事件仅持续16至20s.
达到目标不会结束一集。
相反,成功是独立于物理轨迹来确定的,从执行记录中核实离线,并拒绝代理。
因此,代理人必须决定任务何时完成,以便将其完工要求与实际结果进行比较。

blocks.en:
Beyond task success and API cost per episode, we measure two aspects of interface behavior. Decision burden is characterized by model turns per episode and, for programs, actions executed per program. Completion judgment is evaluated through three rates ( Tab. 6 ): the fraction of episodes declared complete, the fraction of completion claims that are false, and the fraction of failed episodes that end in a completion claim.
Together, these measures distinguish execution performance from the agent’s ability to recognize task completion.
blocks.zh:
除了任务成功和每集API成本外,我们测量界面行为的两个方面. 决策负担的特点是每集模式转弯,对于每个节目,则执行动作. 完成判决通过三种费率(表6)来评价:宣布完成的几集的分数,虚假的完成索赔分数,以及以完成索赔结束的失败几集的分数。
这些措施共同区分了执行业绩和代理人确认任务完成的能力。

blocks.en: 4 RUIKit
blocks.zh: 4 卢比基特

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Overview of RUIKit. The RUI is the only variable for a fixed agent and task, while the harness, 24 underlying tools, evaluation protocol, and robot backend remain shared.
The scorer’s verdict is withheld from the agent.
blocks.zh:
图3:RUIKit概况. RUI是固定代理和任务的唯一变量,而牵引,24个基础工具,评价协议和机器人后端仍然共享.
计分员的裁决不向代理人提出。

blocks.en:
RUIKit provides a unified framework for constructing and evaluating robot-use interfaces ( Fig. 3 ).
It separates interface design from the underlying perception, control, and agent infrastructure.
For a given agent and task, only the RUI varies , while the harness, tools, evaluation protocol, and simulator remain fixed across RUIs.
blocks.zh:
鲁伊 Kit提供了构建和评价机器人-使用界面的统一框架(图3).
它将界面设计与基础感知,控制和代理基础设施区分开来.
对于给定的代理和任务,只有RUI不同,而RUI的利用、工具、评价协议和模拟器仍然固定不变。

blocks.en: 4.1 Interface Design Space
blocks.zh: 4.1 界面设计空间

blocks.en:
Robot-use interfaces differ in what actions they expose and how those actions are organized for execution.
We characterize this design space along two complementary axes: action abstraction and interaction form ( Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
机器人-使用接口在它们暴露哪些行动以及如何组织这些行动加以执行方面各不相同。
我们按照两个互补轴来描述这一设计空间:动作抽象和相互作用形式(图1)。

blocks.en:
This axis determines how actions are composed and when control returns to the agent.
In the per-action form, each model reply issues at most one action per arm, after which control returns to the agent.
In the program form, the agent writes a Python program [ 52 ] that composes actions through sequences, loops, and conditional branches.
Programs can also query observations and adapt subsequent actions without another model reply.
For a given abstraction, both forms use the same action primitives , so they differ only in how actions are organized.
blocks.zh:
此轴决定动作的构成以及控制返回代理时.
在每个动作表中,每个模型最多每个臂一个动作回答问题,然后控制返回代理.
在程序格式中,代理写一个Python程序[52],通过序列,循环,和有条件的分支来编程动作.
程序也可以查询观测结果,并调整后续行动,而无需另一个模型回复.
对于给定的抽象,两种形式都使用相同的动作原始,所以它们只在动作的组织方式上有所不同.

blocks.en:
Crossing six action abstractions with two interaction forms yields 12 fixed RUIs.
We also introduce RUI-Free, which exposes all abstractions in both forms and lets the agent choose, giving 13 interfaces.
Per-action RUIs are named by their abstraction, such as skill , while program-based RUIs use the prefix program , such as program-skill .
Importantly, Skill and Program represent different forms of delegation: skills encapsulate predefined robot operations , whereas programs compose operations through agent-generated code .
They can therefore be combined rather than treated as alternatives.
All configurations share the same infrastructure, allowing either axis to vary while the other stays fixed.
blocks.zh:
跨越6个动作抽象与两个相互作用形式产生12个固定的RUI.
我们还引入了RUI-Free,它以两种形式暴露所有抽象,让代理选择,给出13个接口.
个人行动 RUIs通过它们的抽象来命名,例如技能,而基于程序的RUIs使用前缀程序,例如程序技能.
重要的是,技能与程序代表着不同形式的授权:技能包罗预先定义的机器人操作,而程序则通过代理生成的代码构成操作.
因此,它们可以合并,而不是作为替代办法对待。
所有配置都共享相同的基础设施,允许任意一轴变化,而其他的则保持固定.

blocks.en: 4.2 Unified Agent Harness
blocks.zh: 4.2 统一代理

blocks.en:
RUIKit provides 24 underlying tools across six families ( Figs. 3 and 8 ).
All RUIs share the same perception and control infrastructure, including camera observation, object detection and segmentation, depth-based 3D localization, and robot-state estimation.
Shared utilities further support memory, visual marking, object tracking, grasp and motion planning, and reachability checks.
Agents also access task information, such as instructions, demonstrations, and events, and issue waiting, stopping, completion, or give-up commands through common tools.
Only the exposed action commands and their interaction form vary across RUIs.
blocks.zh:
RUIKit为6个家庭提供了24种基本工具(图3和图8)。
所有RUI都拥有相同的感知和控制基础设施,包括相机观测,物体检测和分区,基于深度的3D本地化,以及机器人状态估计.
共享的公用设施进一步支持内存、视觉标识、物体跟踪、把握和运动规划以及可达性检查。
特工还获取任务信息,如指令、示威和活动,并通过通用工具发布等待、停止、完成或放弃命令。
只有曝光的动作命令及其相互作用形式在 RUIs 上有所不同.

blocks.en:
RUIKit implements robot actions and observations as reusable functions.
Each interface selects its action primitives and interaction form, with a versioned identifier such as rui.code-skill/v1 .
Frontier coding agents access these functions through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), while smaller open models use a minimal tool-calling loop.
Programs execute in a sandbox exposing only permitted functions.
Both agent types use the same robot-side infrastructure and interface definitions.
blocks.zh:
RUIKit将机器人动作和观测作为可重复使用的功能执行.
每个接口都选择其动作原始和交互形式,并有一个版本标识符,如rui.code-skill/v1.
边框编码代理通过"模式背景协议"(MCP)访问这些功能,而较小的开放模型则使用最小的工具调用循环.
程序在一个仅披露允许的函数的沙盒中执行 。
两种代理类型都使用相同的机器人侧基础设施和接口定义.

blocks.en:
RUIKit records tool calls, robot trajectories, observations, and outcomes for offline evaluation.
An independent scorer evaluates goal satisfaction, task constraints, and simulation validity from the logged trajectories.
Each session is also audited for unauthorized tool use, file or network operations, and access to benchmark internals.
A real-robot backend for the Franka arm reuses the same interface definitions, tools, and harness, enabling all 13 RUIs to run without modification.
blocks.zh:
鲁伊 Kit记录工具呼叫,机器人轨迹,观测,以及用于离线评价的结果.
独立的计分员从登录的轨迹来评价目标满意度,任务限制和模拟有效性.
每个会话还因未经授权的工具使用,文件或网络操作,以及基准内部的访问而接受审计.
用于Franka臂的真机器人后端重复使用相同的界面定义,工具和驾驭,使得所有13个RUI能够运行而无需修改.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate two frontier coding agents, Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 and Codex with GPT-6 Astra, both at high reasoning effort and connected through MCP ( Sec. 4.2 ).
We also evaluate Qwen3.5-4B [ 62 ] through a minimal agent loop without thinking, both zero-shot and after fine-tuning.
For each of the 12 fixed RUIs, we fine-tune a LoRA adapter [ 32 ] on 300 training trajectories, 30% from successful Qwen3.8-Max episodes and 70% from scripted policies.
About half of the scripted trajectories include injected deviations and recovery.
Training and test seeds are disjoint ( Sec. C.1 ).
blocks.zh:
我们评价两个边疆编码代理商,Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5和Codex with GPT-6 Astra, 两者都是在高度推理努力中并通过MCP连接的(第4.2条)。
我们还通过一个没有思考的最小的代理环路来评估Quen3.5-4B[62],无论是零镜头还是微调后.
对于12个固定的RUI,我们每个都微调了300个训练轨迹的LORA适配器[32],30%来自成功的Qune3.8-Max集,70%来自脚本政策.
大约一半的脚本轨迹包括注射偏差和恢复.
训练和试验种子是脱节的(第C.1节)。

blocks.en:
Each frontier agent runs all 30 tasks with 13 RUIs on five test missions per task, yielding 1,950 simulation episodes per agent.
The small model is evaluated on the 12 fixed RUIs, as RUI-Free has no dedicated training data.
All experiments follow the protocol in Sec. 3.2 .
We report task success, median model turns per episode, and mean API cost.
For the small model, we also report the one-time fine-tuning cost and the per-episode inference cost at GPU rental prices (Train and Test in Tab. 3 ).
blocks.zh:
每个边境特工执行所有30项任务,每个任务执行5次测试任务,每个特工进行1 950次模拟。
该小型模型在12个固定的RUI上得到评价,因为RUI-Free没有专门的训练数据.
所有实验都遵循了3.2 Sec.
我们报告任务成功 每集中位数模型转弯 平均API成本
对于小模型,我们还报告一次性微调成本和按GPU租赁价格计算的每集推算成本(Train and Test in Tab. 3 .).

blocks.en: 5.2 Interface Effects in Simulation
blocks.zh: 5.2 模拟中的接口效果

blocks.en:
Changing only the RUI shifts Claude Code’s success from 45.3% to 80.7%, far exceeding the 2.1-point difference between the frontier agents averaged across all RUIs ( Tab. 3 ).
API cost also varies by nearly threefold.
This shows that the interface is not merely a means of issuing actions: it determines how many decisions an agent makes and what each decision must accomplish.
Importantly, the same interface does not benefit every agent equally.
For Claude Code, programs raise average success from 64.0% to 75.0%, reducing median turns from 30 to 12 and mean API cost from $1.40 to $0.77.
Claude Code composes 3.3 actions per program, and 54% of its programs observe the world after acting.
Codex averages 0.9 actions and typically wraps a single action in code, gaining only 2.7 points from the program form ( Sec. C.2 ).
Skills offer another way to reduce model decisions by encapsulating predefined operations, achieving the fewest turns and lowest costs among per-action RUIs for both agents.
RUI-Free further illustrates the role of interface selection: it achieves 80.7% for Codex, outperforming every fixed RUI, while remaining competitive for Claude Code.
Together, these results suggest that interface affordances matter only when agents can effectively use them .
blocks.zh:
只改变RUI将Claude Code的成功率从45.3%变为80.7%,远远超过了所有RUI(表3)的边境代理人之间平均2.1点的差距。
API成本也相差近三倍.
这表明接口不仅仅是发布行动的手段:它决定了代理人作出多少决定以及每项决定必须完成什么.
重要的是,同样的接口不能平等地惠及每个代理人。
就Claude Code而言,方案将平均成功率从64.0%提高到75.0%,将中位值从30转降至12转,平均API成本从1.40美元降至0.77美元。
Claude Code由每个节目的3.3动作组成,54%的节目在表演后观察世界.
Codex平均为0.9动作,一般在代码中包裹单个动作,从程序形式(sec. C.2 .)只获得2.7分.
技能为减少示范决定提供了另一种方式,包括封装预先定义的操作,实现最少的转弯和每个操作的RUI中最低的成本。
RUI-Free进一步说明了界面选择的作用:它为Codex实现了80.7%,优于每个固定的RUI,同时保持对Claude Code的竞争.
这些结果加在一起表明,只有当代理人能够有效地使用接口时,接口负担才重要。

blocks.en:
The small-model experiments examine whether this ability can be acquired through fine-tuning rather than assumed from model scale.
Zero-shot, Qwen3.5-4B succeeds in only 1.9% of episodes across the 12 fixed RUIs, and does best with Skill (6.7%), which encapsulates whole operations.
Fine-tuning on 300 trajectories per RUI raises its success to 27.3% at a one-time cost of $0.2K to $0.9K, but how much it learns depends on the RUI ( Tab. 3 ).
Abstractions that name a target rather than a motion (Pose, Point, and Skill) reach 35.3% to 46.7% in the per-action form, whereas Joint, Delta, and Step stay between 12.7% and 21.3%.
They also shorten episodes: each costs $0.36 to $0.56, less than any frontier configuration, whereas a Joint or Delta episode costs $1.66 to $2.07.
Programs, in contrast, lower the average success from 29.6% to 25.1% and help only with Joint, whose per-action episodes run longest.
Thus, a good RUI is also easy to learn : the small model learns most where the abstraction removes decisions and per-action execution keeps feedback.
Pose and Skill are the two best per-action RUIs for all three agents, even though Pose scores 0.0% zero-shot.
With per-action Pose, the small model even matches Claude Code with per-action Step (46.7% vs. 45.3%).
blocks.zh:
小模型实验研究了这种能力是否可以通过微调而不是从模型规模中假设来获得.
0射,Quen3.5-4B在12个固定的RUI中只成功1.9%的赛程,并且与Skill(6.7%)合作最好,它囊括了整个操作.
对每个RUI300轨迹进行精细调整,将成功率提升到27.3%,一次性成本为0.2K到0.9K,但其学习的多少取决于RUI(图3).
将目标而不是运动命名(Pose、Point和Skill)的抽象度按行动形式计算达到35.3%至46.7%,而联合、三角洲和Step则保持在12.7%至21.3%。
它们也缩短节目:每集费用为0.36美元到0.56美元,比任何前沿配置都要少,而联合或三角洲剧集费用为1.66美元到2.07美元。
与此相反,方案将平均成功率从29.6%降至25.1%,仅帮助联合组织,其每次行动的时间最长。
因此,一个好的RUI也是容易学习的:小模型学习最多的是抽象去除决定和每个动作执行保持反馈的地方.
Pose和Skill是所有三种药剂的每个动作RUI最好的两个,尽管Pose的分数是0.0%的零射.
与每个行动 Pose,小型号甚至与Claude Code(英语:Claude Code)(46.7% vs 45.3%)的单动作步骤相匹配.

blocks.en: 5.3 Decision Compression and Feedback
blocks.zh: 5.3 决定压缩和反馈

blocks.en: Table 4: Effects of interaction form and action-level checks. Success (%); Turns: median model replies per episode; Cost: mean API cost per episode ($); Failed claimed: the share of failed episodes that end in a completion claim (%). Fine-grained per-action control can fragment a clear plan into repeated model decisions, increasing latency, cost, and opportunities for error.
We call this failure execution fragmentation .
Programs can reduce this burden, but their benefits may come from both action composition and intermediate feedback.
blocks.zh:
精细的按动作控制可以将明确的计划分割成重复的示范决定,增加延迟性、成本和出错机会。
我们称之为失败的处决分裂。
方案可以减轻这种负担,但其好处可能来自行动组成和中间反馈。

blocks.en:
To distinguish these effects, we introduce an action sequence variant that executes multiple actions without intermediate observations and returns their results only at the end.
On the Delta, Step, and Point interfaces, Claude Code improves from 57.8% with per-action execution to 65.6% with action sequences, while median turns fall from 29 to 16.5 ( Tab. 4 ).
Allowing observations and conditional execution within programs further raises success to 75.6%, with 14 turns.
Thus, action composition reduces decision burden, and in-program feedback adds further gains.
blocks.zh:
为了区分这些效果,我们引入了一个动作序列变体,在没有中间观测的情况下执行多个动作,仅在结尾时返回其结果.
在Delta,Step,和Point接口上,克劳德代码从57.8%的每个动作执行率提高到65.6%的动作序列,而中位值则从29转落到16.5(Tab.
在方案内允许观察和有条件执行进一步将成功率提高到75.6%,其中14个回合。
因此,行动构成会减少决策负担,方案内反馈会进一步增加收益。

blocks.en:
These benefits depend on task demands ( Tab. 10 ).
In-context learning tasks benefit substantially from executing known action sequences, while knowledge, discovery, and dynamic tasks rely more on intermediate feedback.
Contact-rich manipulation benefits from neither consistently, suggesting that its required corrections may exceed what current program-level interaction can provide.
The key distinction is therefore not simply short versus long execution, but where feedback can influence the next action .
blocks.zh:
这些好处取决于任务要求(附件10)。
内容内学习任务从执行已知的行动序列中大大受益,而知识,发现和动态任务则更多地依赖于中间反馈.
接触丰富的操纵性从两者中都无法一致地获益,这表明其所需的纠正可能超过目前方案层面互动所能提供的范围。
因此,关键区别不单单是执行时间短,而是反馈可以影响下一步行动的地方。

blocks.en: 5.4 From Simulation to Reality
blocks.zh: 5.4 从模拟到现实

blocks.en:
We evaluate both frontier agents across all 13 RUIs on a Franka Research 3 arm with fixed and wrist cameras.
The evaluation covers five tasks, one per suite: Domino Run (WK3), Build the House (CL3), Egg Hunt (DS2), Simon Says (DI4), and Shape Sorter (CR1).
With five layouts per task, this yields 650 real-robot episodes.
Interfaces and task budgets match simulation, while execution follows wall-clock time.
A human operator independently assesses task success, with additional quality ratings and rollouts reported in Sec. C.3 .
blocks.zh:
我们评价所有13个RUI的边境特工 使用Franka Research 3臂 固定和手腕相机
评价包括五个任务,每个套房一个:Domino Run(WK3),Building the House(CL3),Egg Hunt(DS2),Simon Says(DI4)和Shape Sorter(CR1).
每个任务有5个布局,这产生了650个真机器人集.
接口和任务预算与模拟相匹配,而执行则跟随时钟时间.
人类操作人员独立评估任务成功与否,在Sec.C.3中报告了更多的质量评级和推出情况。

Interface advantages observed in simulation do not necessarily transfer to physical execution ( Tab. 5 ).
For Claude Code, programs outperform per-action execution by 23.3 points in simulation but lose this advantage on the real robot (36.0% vs. 42.0%).
Their sim-to-real drops are 54.0 and 24.7 points, respectively.
Codex shows a smaller shift, with per-action execution slightly outperforming programs on the real robot.
Free choice transfers worst: RUI-Free drops from 100.0% in simulation to 44.0% on the real robot for both agents.
Among action abstractions, Delta leads for both agents, with Pose close behind for Codex.
blocks.zh:
在模拟中观察到的界面优势并不一定转移到物理执行(Tab.5 ).
对于Claude Code,程序在模拟中以23.3分的成绩超过每个动作执行,但在真正的机器人上却失去了这个优势(36.0%对42.0%).
他们的sim-to-Real的跌幅分别为54.0和24.7分.
Codex显示一个较小的转变,在真实的机器人上,每个动作执行都略胜程序.
自由选择转移最差:RUI-Free在模拟中从100.0%下降到44.0%在真实的机器人上为两个代理.
在动作抽象中,德尔塔带领两个特工,Pose紧跟在Codex后面.

blocks.en:
These differences highlight the importance of feedback and local correction under physical uncertainty .
More than in simulation, real execution is affected by depth noise, calibration offsets, and slipping grasps, with the two cameras sometimes locating the same object up to 1.5 cm apart.
Successful trajectories often involve placing an object, inspecting the result, and making incremental corrections.
In contrast, a Claude Code program placed three dominoes without checking their spacing and incorrectly declared completion.
Such cases suggest that the benefit of action composition depends not only on reducing model decisions, but also on preserving opportunities to correct execution errors .
blocks.zh:
这些差异凸显了反馈和在物理不确定性下局部纠正的重要性。
实际执行比模拟更受深度噪声,校准偏移,和滑动抓取的影响,两台相机有时将同一物体定位在1.5厘米的距离.
成功的轨迹往往包括放置物体、检查结果和逐步修正。
相比之下,一个Claude代码程序设置了3个多米诺,而没有检查它们的间隔并错误地宣布完成.
这些情况表明,行动构成的好处不仅取决于减少决定范本,还取决于保留纠正执行错误的机会。

blocks.en:
Some tasks require feedback at timescales or precision levels beyond what model-level interaction can reliably provide.
On the real robot, Simon Says remains challenging because the target moves while the agent reasons.
Codex’s image-point programs provide an instructive exception, using in-program observations to track and reach the target across all five layouts.
This suggests that time-critical reactions may need to operate within programs or lower-level controllers.
blocks.zh:
一些任务需要时间尺度或精确水平的反馈,超出模型层面互动能够可靠提供的.
在真正的机器人上,西蒙·塞斯(英语:Simon Says)仍然具有挑战性,因为目标移动的同时代理商也有原因.
Codex的图像点程序提供了一个具有启发性的例外,利用程序内观测来跟踪并达到所有五个布局的目标.
这表明时间临界反应可能需要在程序或低级控制器内运行.

blocks.en:
Contact-rich manipulation poses a complementary challenge.
In simulation, inserting a graphics card and folding a T-shirt remain difficult across nearly all RUIs.
Their success depends on fine corrections that are poorly resolved by the available observations: a 2 cm T-shirt misalignment spans only about eight pixels in the head camera.
Together, these cases expose the need for feedback and control mechanisms that operate at appropriate temporal and spatial resolutions.
blocks.zh:
大量接触的操纵构成一个相辅相成的挑战。
在模拟中,几乎所有RUI都很难插入图形卡和折叠T恤。
它们的成败取决于通过现有观测得到的精细的校正,这些精细的校正解决不了:一件2厘米T恤的错位只跨过头部相机的大约8像素.
这些情况共同表明,需要以适当的时间和空间分辨率运作的反馈和控制机制。

blocks.en: 5.5 The Verification Gap
blocks.zh: 5.5 核查差距

blocks.en:
Table 6: Completion-judgment diagnostics (%). Online (30 tasks, one test seed): claim rate over episodes, false claims among completion claims, and completion claims among failed episodes.
Post-hoc (23 tasks): failures detected in final frames by a fresh judge and claims made without rechecking. † † nicematrix-placeholder: NiceTabular* (nicematrix)

Beyond executing actions, an agent must determine whether the task has actually succeeded.
Yet 82.1% and 70.9% of failed episodes end in a completion claim for Claude Code and Codex, respectively ( Tab. 6 ).
We call this failure mode illusory completion .
blocks.zh:
除了执行行动外,代理人必须确定任务是否实际成功。
然而,82.1%的失败事件和70.9%的失败事件分别以Claude Code和Codex的完成索赔告终(附件6)。
我们称之为失败模式的虚幻完成

blocks.en:
Crucially, these failures are often visually detectable ( Fig. 5 ).
In an offline analysis of 23 tasks ( Sec. C.4 ), a fresh judge using only the final frames the agent had already received recognizes 70.2% of Claude Code’s false claims and 80.9% of Codex’s.
Most of these claims are made without another observation (69.7% and 92.1%, respectively).
For Codex, the offline judge uses the same underlying model in a fresh context, suggesting that the problem is not simply a lack of visual evidence.
Rather, access to evidence does not guarantee evidence-grounded completion judgments .
blocks.zh:
关键的是,这些故障往往是可视的(图5)。
在对23项任务的离线分析(第C.4节)中,一名刚上任的法官只使用代理商已经收到的最终框架,承认了克劳德法典70.2%的虚假主张和80.9%的法典。
其中大多数索赔没有提出其他意见(分别为69.7%和92.1%)。
对于Codex,离线裁判员在新的上下文中使用了相同的基础模型,说明问题不仅仅是缺乏视觉证据.
相反,获取证据并不能保证基于证据的结案判决。

blocks.en:
We introduce post-condition checks for grasping and placing in the Skill and Program-Skill interfaces.
These checks use only observable robot states and camera measurements, achieving 88.6% agreement with 149 human-verified labels (grasps 97.3%, placements 80.0%) and 94.5% agreement with 524 simulator records.
blocks.zh:
我们实行条件后检查,以掌握和放置技能与程序-技能接口。
这些检查只使用可观察到的机器人状态和相机测量,与149个经人验证的标签(grasps 97.3%,放置80.0%)达成了88.6%的协议,与524个模拟器记录达成了94.5%的协议.

blocks.en:
Despite this agreement, the checks provide limited improvements ( Tab. 4 ).
Reporting failed actions lowers the share of failed episodes that end in a completion claim from 87.5% to 81.2%, and automatic retries lower it to 75.0% without improving task success.
Only 2 of 32 corrections recover a failed grasp.
An agent may successfully execute individual actions while still failing the overall task.
This exposes a fundamental distinction: action-level feedback cannot substitute for task-level verification .
blocks.zh:
尽管有这一协议,但检查提供的改进有限(表4)。
报告失败的行动将结束于完成索赔的失败事件的比例从87.5%降至81.2%,自动重试将其降至75.0%,但没有改善任务成功率。
在32项更正中,只有2项追回了失败的把握。
代理人可能成功执行个别行动,而仍未完成总体任务。
这暴露了一个根本的区别:行动层面的反馈不能取代任务层面的核查。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
What a robot agent can accomplish depends not only on its model, but also on the interface through which it acts.
We introduced RUIBench and RUIKit to systematically study this relationship across 30 agentic manipulation tasks and 13 interfaces.
Our findings reveal that effective RUIs reduce unnecessary decisions while preserving essential feedback , with their benefits shaped by agent behavior and physical uncertainty.
Such interfaces are also easier for small models to learn.
We further uncover a verification gap , where agents frequently declare success despite observable failures.
Together, these results establish RUI design as a fundamental problem of allocating decisions, execution, and feedback between agents and robots. The key is not simply what actions an agent can perform, but when to decide, when to correct, and how to verify success.
blocks.zh:
机器人特工能够实现什么,不仅取决于它的模型,也取决于它通过什么接口来行动.
我们引入了RUIBench和RUIKit,以系统地研究30项代理操纵任务和13个接口的这种关系。
我们的调查结果显示,有效的路运会减少了不必要的决定,同时保留了基本的反馈,其好处由代理行为和身体不确定性决定。
这类接口也更容易让小模型学习.
我们进一步发现一个核查差距,尽管有明显的失败,但特工经常宣布成功。
这些结果共同将RUI设计确立为在代理商和机器人之间分配决定,执行,和反馈的根本问题. 关键不简单是代理人能够采取什么行动,而是何时决定、何时纠正以及如何核实成功。

blocks.en:
Extending the real-robot study beyond five tasks on one arm would test how widely the observed interface shifts hold.
Contact-rich and time-critical tasks remain difficult across nearly all RUIs, calling for feedback and control at finer temporal and spatial resolutions, such as reactions inside programs or lower-level controllers.
Closing the verification gap further requires task-level verifiers that check completion against observations rather than individual actions.
blocks.zh:
将实际机器人研究扩大到一个臂上的五个任务之外,将测试所观测到的接口移位有多广泛。
几乎所有RUI都仍然难以完成接触丰富和时间紧迫的任务,要求以更细的时间和空间分辨率进行反馈和控制,例如程序内部的反应或低级控制器.
缩小核查差距还需要任务一级的核查员对照观察而不是个别行动检查完成情况。

blocks.en:
A mission is a task instance generated from a fixed seed.
The seed sets the object poses and hidden variables, such as the pot that hides the egg.
Each task has 15 development missions (seeds 0 to 14) and 20 test missions (seeds 15 to 34). Table 3 uses the first five test missions of every task. Tables 4 and 6 and the simulation column of Tab. 5 use the first.

任务是由固定种子生成的任务实例.
种子设定物体的姿势和隐藏变量,如隐藏卵的锅.

blocks.en:
Each task has a turn budget and a time limit on the episode clock, equal to the budget times 8 s and capped at 30 min.
The scorer of each task decides success at the end of the episode from the recorded object states and can recompute it from the logs.
Success requires the goal state, no violation of the task rules, and no alarm from a physics audit.
The audit flags numerical anomalies, articulated objects beyond their joint limits, objects faster than 6 m/s, and objects jumping over 3 cm without contact.
blocks.zh:
每项任务都有回合预算和剧集时钟的时间限制,等于预算时长8s,30分钟上限.
每个任务的计分员从录制对象状态决定剧集结束时的成功,并且可以从日志中重新计算.
成功需要目标状态,不违反任务规则,也不需要物理审计的警报.
审计标志的数值异常,表达对象超出其联合界限,对象速度快于6米/秒,物体跳跃超过3厘米而不接触.

blocks.en:
The scripted reference solves all 70 control missions, the first five test missions of 14 tasks.
Each control runs it without one kind of information.
Without demonstrations, it fails on all 20 missions of CL1, CL2, CL4, and CL5; CL3 draws its goal on a card in the scene, and CL6 states its rule in text.
Planning from the first frame alone, it succeeds on 4 of 35 missions of discovery and dynamic tasks (DS1 to DS5, DI5, and DI6), each time by guessing.
Ignoring mid-episode changes, it succeeds on 2 of 15 missions of tasks whose target or instruction changes (CL6, DI2, and DI4).
Thus, the tested tasks depend on the information that defines their suite .
blocks.zh:
脚本参考书解全部70个控制任务,前5个测试任务共14项任务.
每个控制器运行它 没有一种信息。
没有示威,它在CL1,CL2,CL4和CL5的所有20次任务上都失败了;CL3在现场的一张卡片上画出它的目标,CL6在文本中阐述了它的规则.
单从第一个框架进行规划,它就成功完成35项发现和动态任务的4项任务(DS1至DS5、DI5和DI6),每次都通过猜测。
它忽略了中层变化,在目标或指令发生变化的15个任务中,成功完成了2个任务(CL6、DI2和DI4)。
因此,测试任务取决于界定其套房的信息。

blocks.en:
SAM 3 [ 10 ] detects and segments objects in the rendered images, and sensor depth lifts them to 3D.
In simulation, each camera pose carries a calibration error of 3 mm and 0.3°, fixed for a mission.
Depth carries a per-pixel error of 1 mm plus 0.3% of the distance, fixed for a viewpoint, so repeated looks do not average it out.
Positions therefore come from the sensors rather than the simulator, with smaller errors than on the real robot, where the two cameras can place an object up to 1.5 cm apart ( Sec. 5.4 ).
After every reply that moves an arm, the harness returns the latest images of all cameras with the result.
blocks.zh:
SAM 3[10]探测到成像中的物体和片段,传感器深度将其提升到3D.
在模拟中,每台相机的姿势都带有3毫米和0.3°的校准误差,固定在任务上.
深度携带每像素误差1毫米加0.3%的距离,固定在一个视点上,所以重复的外观不平均出来.
因此,位置来自传感器而不是模拟器,其误差小于真正的机器人,两个相机可以将一个物体放置在1.5厘米以内(第5.4节).
在每次对一个手臂的回复后, 吊带会带着结果返回所有摄像机的最新图像。

blocks.en: Appendix C Experimental Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 细节

blocks.en: C.1 Small Model
blocks.zh: C.1 小模型

blocks.en:
For each of the 12 fixed RUIs, the training set holds 300 trajectories from seeds disjoint from the test seeds.
Of these, 90 are successful Qwen3.8-Max episodes and 210 come from scripted policies.
Qwen3.8-Max runs in the same minimal loop and RUI as the small model, and we keep only the episodes that the benchmark scorer marks successful, without their reasoning.
The scripted policies plan with privileged state but act only through the commands of the RUI, with the same tools, clock, and budgets as at test time, so every trajectory is a valid episode of that RUI.
About half of the scripted episodes add an error to the target pose of the hand in 30% to 60% of the replies that move an arm, with standard deviations of up to 8 mm in position and 4° in yaw, whatever the abstraction.
The policy then replans from the resulting state.
Replies whose execution carries such an error stay in the history of later steps but are not training targets, so the model learns the corrections without learning to make the errors.
blocks.zh:
对于12个固定的RUI, 训练集各有300个轨迹,从试验种子中分离出来。
其中90集是成功的Qwen3.8-Max集,210集来自脚本政策.
Quen3.8-Max运行在与小模型相同的最小循环和RUI中,我们只保留基准计分员标记成功的几集,没有他们的推理.
剧本政策计划以特权状态进行,但只通过RUI的指令行动,在测试时间有相同的工具,时钟和预算,所以每个轨迹都是RUI的有效插曲.
大约一半的剧本片段在移动手臂的30%到60%的回复中给手的目标姿势增加了一个错误,标准偏差在位置上可达8毫米,在yaw中可达4°,无论抽象.
政策随后从由此产生的状态中重新制定。
其执行中带有这种错误的回答停留在后期步骤的历史中,但不是训练目标,所以模型在学习更正时没有学会出错.

blocks.en:
Each RUI has its own LoRA adapter [ 32 ] of rank 64 ( α = 128 \alpha=128 ) on all linear layers of the language model, while the vision encoder stays frozen.
All 12 adapters share the data recipe, the number of trajectories, and the training schedule.
Training runs for 10 epochs with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , cosine decay, and 32 requests per batch.
Each training example is one request exactly as RUIKit sends it, with the system prompt, the tools, the text history, and the latest six images, and the loss covers only the reply.
At test time, the model runs in the minimal loop without thinking, with the same tools, limits, and 8 s clock as the frontier agents, on the 150 test episodes of each RUI.
blocks.zh:
每个RUI在语言模型的所有线性层上都有自己的64级(α = 128\alpha=128)的LORA适配器[32],而视觉编码器则保持不变.
所有12位适配器都共享数据配方,轨迹数量,以及培训时间表.
为10个学期开展培训,学习率为10 - 4 10 - 4 = , 余弦衰减,每批有32项请求。
每个训练例都是RUIKit发出的一个完全一样的请求,系统即时,工具,文本历史,以及最新的六幅图像,损失只覆盖答复.
在测试时间,模型运行在最小的循环中,没有思考,拥有与边疆特工相同的工具,限制,以及8个时钟,在每个RUI的150个测试片段上.

blocks.en:
Abstractions that name a target shorten the small model’s episodes.
In the per-action form, Point and Skill episodes take a median of 29 and 23 replies, against 53 for Joint and 36 for Delta.
Programs cut Joint, the longest, to 37.5 replies, in line with their gain on Joint alone ( Sec. 5.2 ).
Train cost charges $2.68 per H200 GPU-hour and $4.06 per B200 GPU-hour.
Test cost charges one dedicated inference GPU that keeps the model loaded, as a deployed robot would, for the wall-clock duration of each test episode, including the time spent executing actions.
blocks.zh:
给目标命名的缩略语缩短了小模型的片段 。
按每个动作形式来看,Point和Skill事件的答复中位数为29和23,而Joint为53,Delta为36。
联合方案最长,根据它们对联合方案的收益,将答复减少到37.5份(第5.2条)。
列车费用每H200 GPU小时收费2.68美元,每B200 GPU小时收费4.06美元.
测试成本收取一个专门的推论GPU,使模型继续加载,因为部署的机器人会在每个测试插曲的时长,包括执行动作花费的时间.

blocks.zh: C.2 方案和反馈

表10:Tab的相互作用形式。 4通过套房和抽象。 Claude Code第一次测试任务的成功率(%),每套有18集,每抽象有30集.

blocks.en:
Programs raise Claude Code’s success by 11.0 points but Codex’s by only 2.7 points ( Tab. 3 ). Table 10 explains the difference.
Claude Code’s programs contain 3.3 actions on average, and 54% of them observe the world after acting.
Codex’s programs contain 0.9 actions on average, and its median program is a single line.
On the same tasks and abstractions, Claude Code’s programs win 32 of the 40 pairs in which only one form succeeds, while Codex’s win 20 of 34.
Thus, the program form pays off when the agent uses it to compose actions with feedback .
blocks.zh:
节目将Claude Code的成功提升了11.0分,但Codex只提升了2.7分(Tab. 3). 表10解释了差异。
Claude Code的节目平均包含3.3个动作,其中54%在动作后观察世界.
Codex的程序平均包含0.9个动作,其中位数程序为单行.
在同样的任务和抽象上,克劳德法典的节目赢得了40对中只有一种形式成功的32对,而柯德克斯赢得了20对34.
因此,程序表在代理者使用它来用反馈来作曲动作时得到回报. .

blocks.en:
Table 10 breaks the interaction-form ablation of Tab. 4 down by suite and abstraction.
For each of the three abstractions, success rises from per-action execution to action sequences and again to programs, and the suites follow the pattern that Sec. 5.3 describes.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: C.3 Real Robot
blocks.zh: C.3 真正的机器人

blocks.en:
Figure 4: Real-robot rollouts on the first layout. Each row shows four frames of one episode from the third-person camera.
On the same task and layout, Claude Code topples the whole chain with per-action Delta (a), but only the blue domino falls, sideways, after its program (b).
Per-action episodes also recover from a beam that lands beside its supports (c) and a cube that rests tilted on the lid (d).

图4:第一版布局上的真机器人推出. 每列从第三人称相机显示四帧一集.
在同一任务和布局上,克劳德代码用每个动作的Delta(a)来覆盖整个链条,但在其程序(b)之后,只有蓝色多米诺坠落,侧面.
偶发事件还从位于其支撑(c)旁的光束和倾斜在盖(d)上的立方体中恢复。

blocks.en:
The real station uses the Franka Research 3 arm of Sec. 5.4 with a Franka Hand, a fixed RealSense D435 across the table, and a wrist-mounted D405.
The harness, RUIs, tools, and perception code run unchanged on a real-robot backend.
The backend sends setpoints at 50 Hz to impedance controllers, which follow minimum-jerk paths under speed limits.
Before each motion, the backend previews the path on a kinematic model and checks the workspace, hand tilt, and joint limits.
A motion that cannot be completed stops at its last reachable point and returns blocked , as in simulation.
During the motion, the arm stops when tracking error, joint positions, or joint speeds exceed their limits.
Perception adds no synthetic noise to the real sensors.
A ChArUco board on the table calibrates both cameras, and time follows the wall clock, including the agent’s reasoning.
A separate camera, which the agent never sees, records each episode for the figures and videos.
An operator supervises every episode for safety and can pause the arm or stop the episode, which then counts as a failure.
blocks.zh:
真正的车站使用5.4 Sec.的Franka Research 3臂,并配有Franka Hand,对面的固定RealSense D435,以及手腕挂载的D405.
牵引装置、RUIs、工具和感知码在真正的机器人后端上运行。
后端向阻碍控制器发送50赫兹的设置点,在速度限制下遵循最小的jerk路径.
在每次运动前,后端在运动模型上预览路径,并检查工作空间,手倾斜,以及联动限制.
无法完成的运动在最后可到达点停止,返回被阻挡,就像模拟一样。
在运动期间,手臂在跟踪错误,联合位置,或联合速度超过极限时停止.
感觉在真实的传感器上没有增加合成噪音.
桌子上的ChArUco板校准两台相机,时间跟随墙钟,包括代理商的推理.
代理商从未见过的单独的摄像头记录每集数字和视频.
操作员监督每集的安全性,并且可以暂停手臂或停止该集,然后算作失败.

blocks.en:
Each real task keeps the goal of its simulated counterpart with physical objects ( Fig. 2 ); for example, the dominoes must topple onto a toy rather than ring a bell.
Each task runs on five fixed layouts, the same for every RUI and agent, with the turn budgets and time limits of simulation.
Because the objects differ, Finding 3 compares interfaces within each world.
After each episode, the operator judges success by the written criterion of the real task and rates each success from 1 to 5 in half-point steps.
We count failures as 0 and rescale the ratings to 100.
The ratings preserve the orderings of Tab. 5 , with per-action execution ahead of programs for both Claude Code (30.1 vs. 27.7) and Codex (44.1 vs. 41.5).
blocks.zh:
每个真正的任务都保留其模拟对等对象与物理对象的目标(图2);例如,多米诺人必须把玩具上铺而不是按铃.
每个任务按五个固定的布局运行,每个RUI和代理都一样,并带有回合预算和模拟的时间限制.
由于对象不同,发现3比较了每个世界内部的界面.
每集之后,操作者通过真实任务的书面标准判断成功,并将每集成功从1到5分评分为半点步骤.
我们把失败计为0,并将收视率调整为100。
收视率保留了 Tab. 5 的订单,对 Claude Code (30.1 vs 27.7) 和 Codex (44.1 vs 41.5) 的每个动作执行都领先于程序.

blocks.en: C.4 Completion Judgment
blocks.zh: C.4 完成判决

blocks.en:
Figure 5: Illusory completion in simulation. Each column crops the last camera image returned to the agent before it called task_done , and the red circle marks the failure that the judge names.
Codex notes the fallen piece yet reports the goal as reached, whereas the same model, given only these images in a fresh context, recognizes the failure: observing a failure does not guarantee recognizing it.
blocks.zh:
图5:模拟模拟中的模拟完成。 每列收割,最后一幅相机图像在调用任务_done之前返回代理,红色圆圈标志着法官命名的失败.
Codex注意到掉落的片段却报告了所达到的目标,而同一个模型,在新的上下文中只给出这些图像,就承认失败:观察失败并不能保证承认它.

blocks.en:
The judge is GPT-6 Astra in a fresh context.
It receives the instruction, the hint, and the last images of every camera that the harness returned to the agent before it called task_done .
It decides success or failure from these images alone and states its reason.
The post-hoc set of Tab. 6 keeps the 23 tasks on which the judge can recognize success from these images.
On six tasks, the outcome is hard to see in a final frame, such as a tune that was played (CL1) or an acid that was identified (DS5), and the judge rejects many true completions.
We leave out these tasks (CL1, CR2, DI4, DI5, DS5, and WK2) so that judge errors do not count as visible failures, together with CR6, on which neither agent succeeds on the first test mission.
On the 23 tasks, the judge confirms 95.4% of Claude Code’s true completions and 98.7% of Codex’s.
Its detection of false claims therefore reflects failures that the final frames show, as in the two Codex episodes shown in Fig. 5 .
blocks.zh:
法官是全新的GPT-6 Astra。
它收到指令,提示, 以及每个相机的最后图像,
它仅从这些图像中决定成败,并说明了它的理由。
后浩克组塔布. 6保留了法官可以从这些图像中识别成功的23项任务.
在6项任务上,结果很难在最终框架中看到,比如演奏的曲调(CL1)或识别的酸(DS5),法官拒绝许多真正的完成.
我们省略了这些任务(CL1,CR2,DI4,DI5,DS5和WK2),这样判断错误就不会算作明显的失败,加上CR6,在第一次测试任务上两个代理都没有成功.
在23项任务中,法官确认克洛德法典95.4%的完成率和法典98.7%的完成率。
因此,它对虚假索赔的发现反映了最终框架显示的失败,如图5所示的两集法典。
